summary: Copies fifteen default vehicle setup parameter values from a source table at this+0x496C..0x49A4 into the working parameter slots, clamping each copied value to its stored minimum/maximum bounds. Twelve integer parameters and one float parameter are clamped via ClampByRange/FloatClamp helper calls, one byte parameter via ByteClamp, and the final three integer parameters are clamped with inline comparisons. Returns constant 1. Called once from F_5StepInit (0x004B0720).

local_names.this: vehicle setup object; source defaults table at 0x496C..0x49A4, per-parameter (dest, min, max) triples
local_names.v27..v37: inlined max/min bound loads passed to the clamp helpers
